title: noema-lite shared definitions (noema.common/v1)
description: The building blocks every other noema-lite schema refers to: ids, locales, plain texts and the levels model (tools/CONTENT_SPEC.md "Levels", docs/CURRICULUM.md §11). Not a file format of its own.

text.description: A text that is not empty or only blanks.

subjectId.description: A subject (pack) id: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 2–61 characters.
subjectId.x-message: must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (2–61 characters)

locale.description: A UI-style locale code (BCP 47): el, fr, pt-PT, zh-Hant, ar-EG.
locale.x-message: is not a locale code (e.g. el, fr, pt-PT, zh-Hant)

language.description: A language tag (BCP 47, loose): en, el, pt-BR, zh-Hans.
language.x-message: is not a language code (BCP 47, e.g. en, el, pt-BR)

sha256.x-message: is not a SHA-256 hex digest

isoTime.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time (annotation: not checked beyond being a text).

levelId.description: The id of a level of a ladder (a grade, a semester, a year, a difficulty…): lower-case letters, digits, . _ -.
levelId.x-message: is not a level id (lower-case letters, digits, . _ -; at most 41 characters)

levelKind.description: What a ladder of levels counts: school grades, semesters, years of study, difficulty, or anything else.

level.description: One rung of a ladder. order: its place (0 = the lowest); two levels of one ladder never share an order. names: the level's name in each locale (at least one).

levels.description: A ladder of levels, lowest first is customary but order decides.

levelRange.description: From one level to another of the same ladder (both included).

levelRef.description: One level, or a range of levels.

packLevels.description: The levels a pack teaches: one or more level ids of its Roadmap's ladder, or — for a pack without a Roadmap — its own ladder (usually kind difficulty).
